dedupe_keys.name: teaser tool for energy analysis and simulation for efficient retrofit

description: TEASER generates archetype buildings from few inputs and exports ready-to-run dynamic Modelica simulation models, so that building performance simulation can be used at urban scale. It is developed at RWTH Aachen University's E.ON Energy Research Center, Institute for Energy Efficient Buildings and Indoor Climate; version 1.3.1 was released on PyPI on 11 December 2025. It offers an interface to several data sources, enriches missing building data with archetypes, and writes models for Modelica libraries built on the IBPSA library: AixLib, BESMod, Buildings, BuildingSystems and IDEAS. Coverage: any building stock; archetypes reflect the project's typology data. Access: pip install, GitHub, documentation and Jupyter examples. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: needs a Modelica simulation environment to run the exported models, and reduced-order models simplify geometry. Simulation uses: hourly or finer heat demand of building stocks for district heating, storage and retrofit studies. Related records: the Modelica Buildings and IBPSA libraries and City Energy Analyst.
